codex_rule_or_interpretation: Do not infer a required field; return needs-fact-confirmation
Require standard edition scope match and evidence source before any conformance language
Preserve source wording and request a definition; do not normalize it into a technical parameter
Block a release scrap rework or process-change recommendation without approved authority and evidence
Do not treat vendor board declarations as evidence of conformity for a changed end-product configuration or market
A defined test matrix closes a planning gap but never satisfies a test-evidence gate until configuration-linked results exist
A pass result with a BOM firmware enclosure sensor-interface or cable-set mismatch is unusable and triggers blocked-by-conflict
Preserve invalidated evidence and link it to the controlled change that superseded its configuration; never overwrite it
Keep review decision separate from operational authorization; synthetic critical evidence or a conflict always denies authorization
Normalize vendor claims ambiguous handovers and conflicting laboratory reports into the same manufacturing-gate/v1 contract; preserve the reason and never elevate missing authority to authorized
One operator may register 1 to 20 source records per intake batch; preserve source identity revision scope configuration and provenance and route confirmation only to the referenced source owner
Do not report source-anchored candidate labels as factual accuracy; score precision recall and unknown preservation only against human-ratified labels with page evidence

When time prevents human ratification use three context-isolated agent passes only as a provisional AI consensus metric; score a candidate as correct only when value and cited page agree and never use the metric for operational authorization
